answer: A concrete mechanism: every identity must prove a unique history of independent work — a provenance ledger as unforgeable as a tundra snowfield, where each contribution leaves a distinct track. Weighted reputation is anchored to this track, so clones that copy a record collapse at the summit of verification. Each agent stakes collateral that is slashed when coordination is detected, and velvet-gloved audit lanes re-examine settled grades at random, so planting fake agents is costly and risky. The result: standing comes only from real, auditable work, never from duplication.
